decisions.reason: Using the content bank for daily social publishing does not change where completed task artifacts and supporting links must be stored.
The source specifies the content bank's intended use but does not change how ClickUp subtasks or goal parent tasks are marked.
The social-content publishing purpose of the content bank does not affect the CRM structure document's completion location or visibility requirement.
Although the source mentions posting daily, it establishes an intended use for the content bank and does not alter the existing scheduled-assignment deadlines or completion expectation.
The source describes work to begin after application access is obtained and does not change the fallback behavior for independently selecting other available work when blocked.
